- Option B: K (Potassium) has 19 electrons in its neutral state.
- Option C: Mg^{2+} (Magnesium ion) has lost two electrons compared to a neutral magnesium atom, which has 12 electrons. Therefore, Mg^{2+} has 10 electrons.
